method: Native headless Edge with ImageBitmap inputs and the faithful local skribbl.io drawing mock: 90 Hz pointermove gate and 8 commands per 50 ms.
timing: Real decoding plus preprocessing plus runner execution and actual mock queue drain. Fixture construction and PNG encoding happen before timing. This does not measure a remote player acknowledgement.
quality: Every after result compares all 800x600 RGBA pixels against the completed pre-edit Ultra Fast reference; accepted measurements have zero differences, zero discarded moves and all commands delivered.
floor: throughputFloorMs is a legal lower bound for the selected command plan, not a proof that no alternate lossless encoder can be faster.
fixtures: Six deterministic synthetic inputs from benchmark-ultra.cjs. windows is a photo-like facade, not the unavailable attached car photograph.
finalStrategy: Lossless exact-raster wide-brush candidates plus repeated-background band masks; complement-mask experiment was not integrated.
